name: policyPaths
description: Additional policy files or directories to load.

name: adminPolicyPaths

name: general.preferredEditor
description: The preferred editor to open files in. Must be one of the built-in supported identifiers. Use /editor in the CLI to pick interactively, or leave unset to use $VISUAL/$EDITOR.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.preferredEditor behavior.

name: general.openEditorInNewWindow
description: Open VS Code-family editors in a new window when editing files.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.openEditorInNewWindow behavior.

name: general.vimMode
description: Enable Vim keybindings
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.vimMode behavior.

name: general.defaultApprovalMode
description: The default approval mode for tool execution. 'default' prompts for approval, 'auto_edit' auto-approves edit tools, and 'plan' is read-only mode. YOLO mode (auto-approve all actions) can only be enabled via command line (--yolo or --approval-mode=yolo).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.defaultApprovalMode behavior.

name: general.devtools
description: Enable DevTools inspector on launch.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.devtools behavior.

name: general.enableAutoUpdate
description: Enable automatic updates.

name: general.enableAutoUpdateNotification
description: Enable update notification prompts.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.enableAutoUpdateNotification behavior.

name: general.enableNotifications
description: Enable terminal run-event notifications for action-required prompts and session completion.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.enableNotifications behavior.

name: general.notificationMethod
description: How to send terminal notifications.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.notificationMethod behavior.

name: general.checkpointing.enabled
description: Enable session checkpointing for recovery
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.checkpointing.enabled behavior.

name: general.plan.directory
description: The directory where planning artifacts are stored. If not specified, defaults to the system temporary directory. A custom directory requires a policy to allow write access in Plan Mode.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.plan.directory behavior.

name: general.plan.modelRouting
description: Automatically switch between Pro and Flash models based on Plan Mode status. Uses Pro for the planning phase and Flash for the implementation phase.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.plan.modelRouting behavior.

name: general.retryFetchErrors
description: Retry on "exception TypeError: fetch failed sending request" errors.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.retryFetchErrors behavior.

description: Maximum number of attempts for requests to the main chat model. Cannot exceed 10.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.maxAttempts behavior.

name: general.debugKeystrokeLogging

description: Enable automatic session cleanup

name: general.sessionRetention.maxAge
description: Automatically delete chats older than this time period (e.g., "30d", "7d", "24h", "1w")
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.sessionRetention.maxAge behavior.

name: general.sessionRetention.maxCount
description: Alternative: Maximum number of sessions to keep (most recent)
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented general.sessionRetention.maxCount behavior.

name: general.sessionRetention.minRetention
description: Minimum retention period (safety limit, defaults to "1d")

name: general.topicUpdateNarration

name: general.logRagSnippets
